extraction_notes: Only the public Foodpanda page for the exact BreadTalk IHQ outlet and the official Subway Singapore menu page were inspected; no login, CAPTCHA, ordering, or access-control bypass was used.

Foodpanda menu page variants were represented inconsistently by search/open snapshots: search result indicated a crawl around two weeks ago with newer breakfast/menu content, while opened page content indicated a crawl around one month ago and still included a National Day promotional section. Menu prices are recorded verbatim as observed, but must not be treated as confirmed current prices until live page confirmation.
Foodpanda states listed prices may differ from in-store prices. Keep these as delivery-channel prices and never overwrite dine-in prices without source-specific labelling.

The ten item+variant keys are absent as exact item-name matches globally and absent under SFA licence SE15131C000 in the current workbook. Candidate insertion would therefore add ten distinct exact-outlet keys.

The image URLs are official Subway Singapore domain image URLs linked from the official menu page, so they are genuine brand-provided image assets. Copyright/reuse permission is not cleared; suitable only as review candidates, not approved for display.

Foodpanda image URLs were deliberately excluded because its terms state platform images and other listed marks are Foodpanda/third-party intellectual property and prohibit copying, reproducing, republishing, posting, transmitting, distributing, or modifying without prior express written consent.
No workbook data was modified. No closure finding was made from this menu-only sweep.
